newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stock gains peter out at close.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stock gains peter out at close.

text.p: Madrid stocks shed most of their earlier gains to close flat on Tuesday, dulled by Wall Street's weaker start, dealers said.
Caution is still setting the tone after recent volatility and ahead of the outcome of this week's Federal Open Market Committee meeting.
But firmer bonds and a rebound in the peseta did help the tone of the market, they added, and trading was less nervous.
The general index rose 0.40 points, 0.09 percent, to 463.09 and the Ibex added 3.56 points, 0.07 percent, to 5,297.62.
Argentaria bank gained 30 pesetas to 5,740 after it sold its insurance portfolio for 20 million stg.
Telefonica shed 10 pesetas to 3,235 amid the share offering of government's last 20.9 percent stake.
Volatility in the peseta and bond markets which was unsettling the market to some extent appeared to have subsided.
Once again it was the Dow calling the tune.
"As usual, it's Wall Street that's setting the pace, and that means we seem to be ignoring what's happening at home," said one trader.
